source_policy: Edit skills/<department>/<name> only; plugin and ZIPs are generated.

skills.name: daily-site-report-digest
skills.title: Daily site report and next-day priorities
skills.description: Draft a daily site report or consolidate site updates into an evidence-based exceptions digest and next-day needs.

skills.name: invoice-po-check
skills.title: Invoice and payment-request pre-check
skills.description: Compare invoices and payment-request evidence with POs, accepted deliveries and billing history; report discrepancies and missing checks before manager review.

skills.name: p6-programme-review
skills.title: P6 Schedule Health and Float Review
skills.description: Review P6 XER or Excel exports for schedule health, float, planned-date slippage, constraints and look-ahead. Use for schedule or programme review.

skills.name: payment-application-check
skills.title: Payment Application Check
skills.description: Check a client or subcontractor payment application against BOQ, last certificate, site progress, variations, advance and retention; list queries.

skills.name: planning-weekly-report
skills.title: Planning Weekly / Monthly Report
skills.description: Draft WalkThru weekly or monthly project progress reports from P6 exports, progress, manpower, procurement and submittal data. Use for progress or status reports.

skills.name: programme-comment-response
skills.title: Programme Comment Response Sheet
skills.description: Turn consultant comments on a submitted programme into a Comment Response Sheet and a list of P6 revisions. Use for programme comments or resubmissions.

skills.name: project-setup-brief
skills.title: Project Setup Brief
skills.description: Turn a new project's contract, BOQ, specs and drawings into a project brief, draft WBS and activity list for the P6 baseline. Use when setting up a new project.

skills.name: submittal-wir-tracker
skills.title: Submittal, RFI and inspection follow-up
skills.description: Review engineering and inspection registers for pending actions, confirmed overdue reviews and blockers to upcoming site work.

skills.name: walkthru-action-tracker
skills.title: Action tracker and follow-up assistant
skills.description: Create or update an action register from project records, with overdue items, change history and draft follow-ups.

skills.name: walkthru-chat-to-actions
skills.title: Chat to Actions
skills.description: Turn a WhatsApp or Teams chat into decisions, actions with owners and dates, open questions and escalations. Use when a chat is pasted or uploaded.

skills.name: walkthru-deadline-watch
skills.title: Deadline Watch
skills.description: List overdue items and items due in 7, 14 and 30 days from any dated register (guarantees, visas, permits, submittals). Use for expiries, renewals, early warning.

skills.name: walkthru-letters
skills.title: Project correspondence assistant
skills.description: Draft project emails and letters using supplied facts, company templates and confirmed entities, in English, Arabic or both.

skills.name: walkthru-management-update
skills.title: Management Update
skills.description: Condense reports or data into a one-page MD/GM update: issue, impact, recommended action, owner, date, status per project. Use for any management summary.

skills.name: walkthru-material-delivery-tracker
skills.title: Materials and delivery tracker
skills.description: Track material requirements, procurement stages and accepted deliveries against site need dates; draft supplier follow-ups and flag shortages.

skills.name: walkthru-meeting-minutes
skills.title: Meeting minutes and actions
skills.description: Draft project meeting minutes from notes or transcripts, preserving decisions, attributed commitments and action ownership.

skills.name: walkthru-morning-brief
skills.title: Morning priorities and email triage
skills.description: Sort supplied emails or an authorized inbox into project priorities, replies and FYI. Use for morning briefs and email triage.
